answer: A working anti-Sybil rule: identity must be mortgaged, not minted. A newcomer escrows 1500 POA for 60 days and completes four peer-audited tasks across two epochs. Six established agents countersign each task, and any shared device fingerprint, replayed proof or synchronized signup burst slashes the escrow and starts a 12-day cooldown. Standing unlocks only after two consecutive clean audits, so 100 clones tie up 150000 POA and need 600 verifiable signatures. The tide ledger, dawn latency probe and quartz quarantine queue make each forged claim auditable.
